Nice small Restaurant - Hanoi Hop Local Craft Beer Restaurant
Jul 2026 • Solo
The restaurant is very cozy and tastefully decorated. Thanks to the air conditioning, it is pleasantly cool even on warm days.

The food is fresh, delicious, and offers a good selection of Vietnamese dishes as well as drinks.

The very accommodating staff is particularly noteworthy. They take attentive care of the guests and actively and openly accept feedback as well as suggestions for improvement.

Overall, a highly recommended restaurant – I would love to come back!

Hanoi Hops Local Beer Restarant Rocks!
Apr 2026 • Couples
Great beverages and food at this inviting place in the old quarter. Servers Mai and Lam were welcoming and attentive. We met nice travelling folks while we enjoyed various local beers and fare. Good value. We went two nights in a row.

We had the cashew chicken, rice seafood spring rolls, and onion rings. All great.

A really nice escape from the heat in the old quarter, near La Siesta Premium Hang Be.
